name: Mass Suggestion

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 PHB; compare every number with the book before setting checked_against.

targets.description: up to twelve creatures you can see that can hear and understand you

upcast.text: Lasts 10 days with a level 7 slot, 30 days with level 8 and 366 days with level 9.

summary: Up to twelve creatures that can hear and understand you make a Wis save or follow a short suggestion.
text: A Charmed target pursues the suggestion (25 words or fewer, nothing obviously harmful) for the duration, until it's done, or until you or your allies damage it.
